item.description: Located an hour from Buffalo, in Chautauqua County (town of Stockton), is the 311-acre Bear Lake Preserve, considered a critical part of the WNY Wildway. The Wildway is a series of interlinked natural thruways that allow animals, birds, insects, etc., to have the unfettered ability to travel from place to place, while accessing food and shelter.
